newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber drops $10 limit on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber drops $10 limit on technical selling.

text.p: CME lumber futures fell their $10-per-tbf limit in the three nearby contracts, largely on techical selling that developed after the higher-priced September contract expired at 1200 CDT, traders said.
Traders said much of selling was technically motivated and did not appear to be linked to any bearish news from the cash markets.

The September contract expired at 1200 CDT at $430.60 per tbf up $12.10, reflecting the tightness of lumber for immediate shipment. However, seasonally demand for lumber eases by November, which had traders anxious to sell that contract after September expired, traders said.
Lumber futures closed up $12.10 to limit down, with September up $12.10 and November limit down at $361.00.
